items.title: James Hunter interviewed by Monk Rowe, Boston, Massachusetts, July 25, 2018
items.q: I said you took out two chords that distinguished it. It was in C something and there was an A flat and I said what did you leave that out for? That’s the best bit. She took it very well.

ctx.x: Yeah it’s nice to hear. What was her name now, this nice lady who covered “Kick It Around.” Lisa Mills. She’s American but she does a lot of her work in England. And she covered “Kick It Around.” She sang it very well but I can’t let her off because she left off these — I said you took out two chords that distinguished it. It was in C something and there was an A flat and I said what did you leave that out for? That’s the best bit. She took it very well.
Do you own your own publishing?
